name: scoop-manifest
body: Scoop manifest: the bucket's `kalide` manifest (`bucket/kalide.json`, bucket `kalide`) using Scoop's standard `architecture` block — `64bit` url+hash for `kalide-windows-amd64`, and `arm64` url+hash for `kalide-windows-arm64` only when released — with plain public release-download URLs of really-knows-ai/kalide (renamed to `kalide.exe`, `bin: kalide.exe`), fetched anonymously. No `pre_install` script and no `KALIDE_GITHUB_TOKEN`. `bucket/README.md` documents the tokenless `scoop bucket add` / `scoop install` / `scoop update` flow.
